tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyud sde spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bdud bzhi dang sgrib gnyis sreg cing tshogs gnyis 'od zer 'gyed byed ces bya ba rje mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa sor bzhag las zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phag mo dang sbyar ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dam pa dang lhag pa'i lha gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan zhing rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pas zhi sogs kyi las rnams bsgrub pa dang*/ dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par bya ba dang*/ sngags dang cho ga'i lhag chad kha dgang ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi las dang*/ rten rab tu gnas pa la sogs pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe sbyin sreg gi las brtsam ste/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las/ sna tshogs las ni rab bsgrub phyir// sbyin sreg las ni bshad par bya// me ni lha yi kha ru gsungs// sbyin sreg de nyid rnam par gnas// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims// tshims nas dngos grub rab tu stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /sbyin sreg gis ni de kun dgang*// zhes dang*/ ci gsungs sbyin sreg byas nas ni// dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs pa dang*// zhes dang*/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ rab gnas la sogs rjes la ni// ma dran pa dang ma nus pa// cho ga ma tshang gyur pa rnams// sbyin sreg gis ni rdzogs par bya// zhes gsungs so// de la 'dir rgyud sde spyi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bdud bzhi dang sgrib gnyis sreg cing tshogs gnyis 'od zer 'gyed byed ces bya ba rigs sngags 'chang ba chen po slob dpon karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa sor bzhag las bzhi myur 'grub ces bya ba las zhi ba'i sbyin sreg khol du phyung ba ste phag mo dang sbyar ba'i las kyi rim pa 'jug pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ thab bca' ba/ yo byad rnams ji ltar bsham pa/ slob dpon gyi chas gos sogs bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sambu ṭi las/ zhi ba thab khung zlum po ni// khru gang tshad tsam thig gdab bya// btab nas khru phyed brkos nas ni// 'og tu sa la mtho gang khung*// tsandan dkar pos ngos dag byug /de'i phyi rol zlum po'i sa// sor bzhi pa yi mu ran yin// ces bstan pa ltar/

gang du sbyin sreg bya ba'i gnas su stegs bu 'du bya ba sogs grub nas/ thog mar thig gdab pa ni// tshangs zur bzhi po legs btab ste// dbus nas lag sor bcu gnyis dang*// slar yang bzhi pa gnyis rim bskor// rgya khyon mchu dang kha khyer yin// de dbus sor bzhi pad lte bskor// tshangs zur dbus gshag gcus thig gdab// pad 'dab brgyad 'byung zhi ba 'grub// de ltar thig rnams gdab par bya// de nas thab khung brtsig na/ zhi ba la mchu'i phyi nang gi thig gnyis kyi bar du zlum por brtsegs pa'i rgya phyed dpangs su yod pa'i kha nas sor bzhi pa'i mchu dor bar rgya dpangs mnyam par sor bzhi pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang bcas pa padma rgyas pa'i dbyibs lta bu nang du ngang gis gzhol ba de'i phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ dbus su pad 'dab brgyad de/ zhi ba las thams cad pa la phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba ljang gu'i steng du rdo rje dkar po/ phyogs kyi 'dab bzhi la rigs bzhi'i lha mtshan/ de yang gtso bo 'pho bas tshe lha mtshan 'pho tshul shes par bya/ dpa' gcig la phyogs kyi mtshan ma mi dgos/ zhi ba kho na'i las yin na padma thams cad dkar po byed pa'am/ yang na pad 'dab kyi mal du phag mo'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bris la lte bar phyag mtshan bri bar bya'o// brko thab byed na kha khyer gyi rtsa thig gi nang du thab rang rang gi rgya'i phyed zabs su brko zhing*/ bris thab la ni dpangs dngos su med kyang bsam pas 'grub bo// thab kyi kha dog dang dbyibs ni gong gi lung dang 'og tu thab skyed chog gis rtogs par 'gyur ro// bud shing ni yam shing so so'i rgyu dang mthun pa'am shug pa sogs dri zhim po dang dgon pa'i ba glang gi lci ba srog chags med pa yang rung ste/ thab kyi dbyibs dang dpangs rnams dang mthun par thab kyi mchu'i nang du dam par brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor rdza'i kong bu las mthun gyi mar gyis bkang ba sdong bu can bzhag go/

shar gyi phyogs su zhi ba yin/ zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor gyi zhal gang du phyogs kyang rung*/ las dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su thab bca' zhing*/ slob dpon ni las dang mthun pa'i phyogs su kha blta ba'am/ yang na sbyin sreg dang 'brel ba'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi zhal nub phyogs su lta bar bzhengs na/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las kun la dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs gang du bya ba dang*/ slob dpon gang du kha blta ba'i 'byung ba'i phyogs gnyis ka mi 'gal bas shin tu 'grig cing legs par mngon no// slob dpon gyi gdan dang 'dug stangs ni/ zhi ba la 'jam pa'i gdan dkar po la padma'i 'dug stangs bya/ dus ni zhi bar bco lnga sogs kyi srod dang tho rangs sogs so so'i las dang mthun pa'i nyams kyis bya'o/// /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ bdag nyid khrus byas las dang mthun pa'i tshon dang dris byugs/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na bdag bskyed thun bsdu yan 'gro bas 'thus shing*/ ma 'brel kyang zhi sogs las thams cad pa yin na cho ga so so'i bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms shing thun bsdus la/ slar rang nyid las kyi he ru kar gsal gdab/ zhi sogs las rkyang pa yin na lha thams cad dkar por bsgom pa sogs su bshad do// 'dir rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs dam lnga tshan lnga'i ya gyal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lha lnga'i dkyil chog la mtshon na/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed thun bsdu sogs bya'o// da lam 'dir phag mo lha lngar sbyar ba'o// 'di nas bzung ste sbyin sreg ma grol gyi bar ngag smra bcad/ lag pa rdor dril/ yid ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar dgos shing*/ rdor dril byin rlabs sngar byas pa med na 'dir byin brlab dgos pas cho ga so so las byung ba ltar ram/

yang na rdor dril la nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gyis sbyangs/ rdor dril mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdor sems yab yum dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa// dbang gi lhar bcas spyan drangs te// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes pa// dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// slar yang dbang lha 'khor bcas kyis// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag spyi bor brtan pa las// mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan gyur// rdor sems yab yum zhu ba las// rdor dril mtshan nyid ldan par gyur// lag gnyis bkan la/ lag mthil g.yas su zla ba dang*// g.yon du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal// bar bsams te pad skor dang bcas pas/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje blangs te gsor/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe āḥ zhes pad skor dang bcas te dril bu blangs la/ slar yang pad skor dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dhā ra yā mi badzra sa twa hī hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod bzhin pas rdo rje gsum gsor/ slar bstod de snying gar bzung ngo*// de nas dril bu gnas brgyad du bskor zhing bsil ba ste dril lce dril bu'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du res mos kyis reg par gsil bzhin par/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li ni pra dzñā pa ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha bi ta badzra dharmā hṛ da yaṃ santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod la pad skor byas te rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing dril bu sgra che ba gsum dkrol bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sgras bskul zhing mchod par bsams te grags stong du mnyam par bzhag go/

//de nas sngon 'gro gtor ma la bdud rtsi sogs bran/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gyis sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūrya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rakta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar skor zhing*/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ badzra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadzra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ/

dṛ shya hoḥ zhes lan gsum mam bzhi'am lngar brjod/ so so'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ pad skor rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa unma da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā dā ya/ i dam ba liṃ gṛhnantu sa ma ya rakṣantu ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra ya tstshantu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣṭaṃḥbhūñdza tha dzi ghra tha pi ba tha ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sa ta su khaṃ bi shuddha ye/ sa hā yi ka bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bzhi brjod/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu so gnyis sogs// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon zhing*// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur zhing*// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang lta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rab 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur// ces gtor ma phyi rol du dor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wā na bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ drag sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyis rdzas dang yo byad kun la brab cing bgegs bskrad/ bsrungs 'khor ni/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi bar thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i dra ba dang*/ gur bla bres su gyur/ hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la seng gdong ma// badzra singha zhes bya ba// steng sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// steng gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la khwa gdong ma// badzra kā ka zhes bya ba// shar sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// shar gyi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la 'ug gdong ma// badzra ullu zhes bya ba// byang sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// byang gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la khyi gdong ma// badzra shwa na zhes bya ba// nub sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// nub kyi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la phag gdong ma// badzra su ka zhes bya ba// lho sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// lho yi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// lha mo'i lus la stag gdong ma// badzra bya ghri zhes bya ba// 'og sgo srung ba'i phra men ma// dzaḥphra men rdo rje'i dus la bab// 'og gi bar chad zlog tu gsol// hūm̐ 'di ltar lha mo ya mtshan can// sgo ma rnams kyis sgo srungs la// mtshams ma rnams kyis mtshams sdoms shig /phyi nang bar chad zlog tu gsol// oṃ badzra bā rā hī hrīḥgha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/

gnod byed sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes srung 'khor brtan par bsgom mo// me sbar ba ni/ gtsubs shing las byung ba'am rung khang las byung ba'i me/ me snod du bzhag ste bsangs chu gtor la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ dpal 'bar la sbar te slar yang bsangs chu gtor la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ badzra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes thab kyi shar lhor bzhag /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing sbar ro// yang bud shing nyung ba lta bus mgyogs par dgos tshe me lha'i gdan bshams nas sam me lha bskyed nas me sbar ba'ang yod do// de nas dkyil 'khor gang yin de'i las sngags sam so so'i snying po bzla dgos par gsungs pas 'dir/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul bas me gsos la/ sambu ṭir/ thab khung kun du ku sha yi// rtse mo drangs por yongs su bskor// zhes pa ltar ku sha'i chun po ma nyams shing ha cang ring thung spangs pa zung du byas pa dag rim par blangs te lag gnyis kyis bzung ba cung zad pad bskor dang bcas te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra sa twa āḥ zhes chun po che ba zung zhig thab kyi steng du rtse shar du blta bas bzhag ste me lha'i gdan du bsam/ chun po gzhan dag ni rang gi phyogs g.yon nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du rim pa ltar rtse mo shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du blta bar stegs bu g.yogs shing snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bas non pa skor thabs su dgram mo// 'di ni me lha'i gdan dang sbyin sreg gi bya ba la srung 'khor du yang 'gyur bas thog mar bya zhing thab bskyed pa'i gong ngam 'og tu byed pa'ang yod do/

/de nas mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥbighnān sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ yig gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i dngos po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po las kyang ches cher lhag pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i bar rgyas par 'gengs shing 'phags pa rnams mnyes par byed pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai widye= shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de nas bsreg rdzas byin brlab ni cho ga so so'i gtor ma'am nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab dgos pas 'dir/ oṃ āḥbighnān gyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūrya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/

lhor ra las rakta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas/ ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la// rnam pa bsreg rdzas so sor gyur/ /ces sbyar te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas blugs gzar g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas dgang gzar bzung ba kha sbyar te mar khu la reg cing*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing la reg ste/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru thams cad la reg ste/ oṃ dzrīṃ swā hā/ rdzas sbyang ba'o// yang sreg rdzas thams cad la reg ste/ oṃ swā hā/ rdzas bkru ba'o/ yang rdzas thams cad la rim par reg ste/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas thab bskyed pa ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs dgos pas/ oṃ āḥbighnān sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ thab khung mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*// hūm̐ las zhi thab zlum po dkar// lag khru gang gi rgya khyon can// rgya phyed dpangs ldan sor bzhi yi// mchu dang kha khyer de steng du// rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba dang*// grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje spras// de dbus padma 'dab brgyad lter// zhi ba'i rdo rjes mtshan par gyur// thab kyi dbus su me dkyil nang*// pad nyi'i steng du ram̐ yig las// zhi ba'i me lha dkar po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis me thab dang*// ril ba 'dzin pa drang srong tshul// ral pa'i tshogs can zhi nyams ldan// gsus 'phyang tshangs skud dkar pos brgyan// ra skyes la gnas 'khor bcas kyi// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros shar lho nas// me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// lag pa'i g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/

ku sha dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yob cing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub pa// thugs rjes sems can don gyi phyir// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs thab kyi shar lhor me tog gcig 'phangs la/ thab kyi shar lhor ku sha yi// gdan la me lha ye shes pa// 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur// bzed zhal so sor chu bzhi sbreng ste/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ pādyaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pa chu bzhi dbul/ de nas lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan pa rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra a na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya haṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes pa/ /dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu zhabs spyi bor brtan pa las// rnam snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan gyur// ces dang me lha'i mchod phreng phul la/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= nai widye= shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes gdan mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// me lha cung zad zhal gdangs pa'i// ljags la ram̐ yig gis mtshan pas// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// na massa manta buddhā nāṃ oṃ agna ye ha bya ka bya wa ha nā ya ā di bya/

zhes lag gnyis rdor dril dang dgang blugs 'dzin zhing byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun byon zan du 'bul te/ spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ces 'dod don gsol zhing sngags tshigs rnams brjod bzhin pas/ lag gnyis rdor dril dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i khu tshur las/ mdzub mo brkyang pas dgang blugs bzung*/ g.yas pa'i blugs gzar gyis mar khu gsum mam bdun sogs dgang gzar du blugs te gang ba dang*/ lag gnyis sngar bcas pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya de kha sbyar la gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis las mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor/ tshul des mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun gyis byon zan dbul/ me pra 'di skabs kho nar brtag pa dang 'di nas brtsams te ji srid thab kyi bud shing rnams kyi nus pa ma rdzogs pa de srid du brtag pa ste lugs gnyis las snga ma ltar brtag la/ de'i tshul ni sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye mar/ rab bsngags dge ba'i me yi 'od// dpal be'u dang ni rnga g.yab gdugs// rgyal mtshan padma lta bu dang*// rtse gsum pa dang ral gri nya// bkra shis ind+ra nī la'i mdog /rdo rje dung la sogs pa dang*// dgang gzar blugs gzar rnam pa dang*// dkar dang 'ja' 'dra mdog sdug dang*// g.yas su 'khyil dang shin tu snum// byi ru dang ni gser mdog 'dra// dngul dang rin chen baiḍūrya// nyi 'od 'bar mtshungs dri ma med// du ba med cing dri zhim pa// mṛ dang ga yi sgra ldan mchog /ces pa rnams kyis dge ba'i ltas shes par bya la/ 'on te mi dge ba'i mtshan ma yang de nyid las/ du ba dku zhing me stag 'phro// kun nas sdang zhing sgra dang bcas// myur du chad cing zhan pa dang*// mdangs rtsub pa la sha yi mdog

/de bzhin ba glang mgo 'dra dang*// mi ro'i dri dang nya'i dri// bong bu'i dri can bgegs yod yin// zhes bstan pa rnams kyis me pra brtag /ngan na bsang chu gtor zhing las sngags dang sumbha ni bgegs bskrad/ ha bya sogs byon zan gyis skabs ltar mar khu dgang gzar gsum mam bdun dbul lo// de nas bsreg rdzas dbul te/ yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing du mos la rtse mo steng du bstan la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ zhes lha sngags tshar gcig rdzas sngags re dang yam shing re bstun te dbul zhing sngags bzla grogs yod na du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yam shing sngags re la dbul/ grangs 'dzin pa pos kyang de nyid kyi grangs 'dzin pa ste/ deng sang sbyin sreg la grangs rkun byed pa'ang 'di nas 'tshugs pa yin pas grangs rkun mi byed cing tshar gsum re'am bdun re'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya/ zhes pa'i rjes su 'dod gsol ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul mthar/ oṃ agna ye/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya swā hā/ zhes til nag mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul/ 'bru gzhan rnams dang ku sha dang dūr wa yang mtheb srin nam gung mtheb kyis dbul/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba artha siddha ye swā hā/ yungs kar te mthar/ oṃ sarba artha siddha ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad dang*// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ zas mchog ste mthar/ oṃ sarba samba de/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de yang zas mchog ril bu yin na mtheb mdzub dang phye ma yin na blugs gzar gyis so// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ zho ste mthar/ oṃ sarba samba de/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes blugs gzar gyis dbul// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras so ba ste mthar/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ so ba ste mthar/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā be gā ye swā hā/ nas te thar/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma ste mthar/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra ghasma re swā hā/ gro ste mthar/ oṃ badzra ghasma re/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// lus kyi nad rnams med pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr wa ste mthar/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// tshe srog ring du gnas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya swā hā/ ku sha ste mthar/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ shing tog ste mthar/ oṃ badzra ṣī bā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de yang sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til lhag par dbul zhing gzhan rnams gang 'byor dang*/ de bzhin du tshe ring bar 'dod na dūr wa dbul ba sogs kun la shes par bya/ mar khu dang yam shing ni thams cad la dgos so// gshin don dang zhi rkyang la ni spel tshig /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// zhes sam yang na/

che ge'i sdig sgrib rgyu bcas kun// zhes pa tsam kha bsgyur bas chog go bde mchog sdom byung sogs las ni/ yam shing ni 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la'o// khu ba'i rdzas rnams ni zhal du'o// gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu'o// ku sha ni gdan du'o// dūr wa dang me tog ni dbu la'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar byed pa'ang yod do// me gso ba'i phyir bar bar du mar khu dgang blugs kyis dbul lo// de nas me lha'i mchod bstod ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i snang gsal 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i dri chab 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wa ra gandhe pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra nai widye pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/

gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// zung 'jug bde chen mchod pa 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra ma taṅgi pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ drang srong chen po me lha yis// sngon gyi dam bcas mna' dor ba// lha rnams zhal ni me yin te// sbyin sreg de ni me la gnas// oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ phag mo lha lngar/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lta bu'i cho ga gang yin gyi las sngags dang bsang chus me dang yo byad rnams bsangs la/ me lha 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'od zhu 'bar ba'i rnam par 'gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga ni/ me lha'i lto ba'am thugs kar ram me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ba'i dbus su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ste lugs gsum las phyi ma ltar byas te/ de'i dbus su zhes mtshams sbyar la cho ga so so'i bdag bskyed kha spos te mdun bskyed dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su sgom pa las 'dir phag mo lha lnga'i cho gar mtshon na thab dbus su dkyil 'khor dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ de'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ kha gdengs che ba gyen du bstan pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba de'i dbus su gdan padma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas jo mo'i skur gyur/

tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim pas chu la nya ldang ba'i tshul du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ de yang chos thams cad chos kyi skur ro gcig pa'i phyir zhal gcig dang ldan pa/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i phyir phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku bdud dpung gi tshogs la khros shing cher khros pa/ sku mdog dmar zhing 'od zer rab tu 'bar bas stong gsum thams cad khyab cing brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i bcud 'phrog par byed pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing gar stabs su 'gying ba/ yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du sbyor bas kha ṭwāṃ ga mchan khung na yar bsgreng ba/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar bcud kyis rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ dus gsum mkhyen phyir rab tu gtum pa'i spyan gsum khrag ltar dmar zhing zlum la g.yo ba/ bdud bzhi 'dul ba'i phyir khro gnyer dang mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing ma mchu tshems kyis mnan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa la rigs lngas mtshan pa'i phyir thod pa skam po lnga'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig yongs su dag pa'i phyir thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ me tog dmar po'i phreng ba dang dril bu g.yer kha dang rus pa'i rgyan cha du mas brgyan pa/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i phyir gdan padma ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs su bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhung du phyogs kyi padma 'dab bzhi la// 'byung bzhi bskyed pa'i sa bon las// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi bskyed// ces dang*/ zhal gdams kyi thog mar/ de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ser mo/

nub tu ni las padma mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa rnams kyi rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ padma dang*/ ral gris mtshan pa'i gri gug bsnams pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i rjes su slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gyi drung du byon te yig brgya brjod bzhin pas mchod yon sbreng spos phor 'dzin pas/ rten nas rdul tshon nam ras bris dkyil 'khor la// bzhugs pa'i brten pa dkyil 'khor pa// thab kyi dbus kyi dkyil 'khor du// deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// zhes snyan gsan dbab ste/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gtso 'khor so so'i snying po brjod bzhin pas me tog lha'i ngo bor mos te/ rdul tshon nam ras bris dkyil 'khor nas len pa'i tshul gyis rin po che'i snod du blangs shing bkur sti dang bcas pas sbyin sreg gi khang par spyan drangs te/ pheṃ pheṃ gyi sgras bskul nas thab kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod pa ni/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs nas/ shabda'i bar dang*/ pañtsa a mṛ ta= badzra ma tadgi= bcas mchod pa gsum gyis mchod cing mthar/ so so'i snying po/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ btags pa brjod cing me tog 'thor de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/

oṃ padma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor bas rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas se gol bya zhing thab tu bzhugs pa sngar bskyed pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs par mos la/ thab kyi padma'i dbus su bzhugs par gyur// ces brjod nas thab kyi dbus su me tog gcig dor te thab tu bskyed pa dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa de la spro na ye shes pa gzhug par bya ba sogs kyang gsungs pas/ 'dir phag mo lha lnga'i cho gar mtshon na/ gtso mo'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i dbus su yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i thugs kar ha ri ni sa yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rol mo bya/ hūm̐/ snang ba chos sku'i gzhal yas nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos dbyings dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// bka' brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol// chos sku spros bral dag pa la// longs sku sgyu ma'i skur bstan pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnal 'byor ma// phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings nas bzhengs// sems can don la dgongs mdzod la// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol// mi 'gyur gnas pa'i gzhal yas nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// bde chen dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// shes rab btsun mo'i bha ga nas// padma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// mchod rten dkar po'i dpal grags nas// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// ro langs 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// steng 'og phyogs mtshams so so nas// chos skyong srung ma gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ā ra li hoḥbadzra wā rā hī/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// padma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul lags na// ci bder bar ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī padma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widye/ shabda/ badzra wā rā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod kyang 'bul/ de rnams kyi sku las rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gyi sku dpag tu med pa byon/ spyi bor thim/ bde ba dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi gsung las/ sngags ā li kā li dkar po dang dmar po'i phreng ba byung*/ mgrin par thim/ mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ de rnams kyi thugs las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin byon/ snying gar thim/ bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lha mo de rnams rang rang gi sku la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ byon zan dbul ba ni/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags la yang*// hūm̐ yig dag gis mtshan pa yis// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// ces pa'i rjes su dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi gtso bo'i snying po phag mor mtshon na/

oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags lan bdun gyis mar khu dgang la mthar spel tshig ni/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de ltar sngags lan bdun re'i mtshams su 'dod gsol lan re bcas lan gsum gyis byon zan phul// de nas mchod bstod so so'i gzhung bzhin las/ 'dir phag mor mtshon na/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i dngos po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po las kyang ches cher lhag pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i bar rgyas par 'gengs shing*/ 'phags pa rnams mnyes par byed pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pādyaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyangs slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i dri ma dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/

pādyaṃ= ā tsa mā naṃ= prokṣa ṇaṃ= dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes gyur pa'i// lha rdzas dbyibs legs me tog dam pa 'di// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin btibs gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldang bas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra dhū pe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// 'od zer snang bas phyogs bcur gsal gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra ā lo ke pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum kun tu dri dang ngad ldan pa'i// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i khrus// ye shes sprin phung thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra gandhe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye ā hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang ma bshams te 'bul lags na// bsod nams zhing gyur rnams kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra nai widye pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dril chen sil snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam dag ngag gis bstod de gus mchod 'bul// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas sangs rgyas sar// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por shog

/oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra shabda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ badzra wā rā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// stong nyid rdo rje ldan pa'i bdag nyid can// bskal pa'i me 'bar 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrogs// rdo rje gtum mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// phag gdong rtog med chos sku 'gyur med ston// khro mo'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// 'gro don rdzogs mdzad 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can// rtog med 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jigs rung dpa' mo ma rungs tshar gcod ma// spyan gsum mche gtsigs sku gsum don dang ldan// nyon mongs gcod mdzad 'jigs pa'i nga ro can// bdud 'dul 'joms ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// skra grol gcer bu skyon bral 'jigs pa'i gzugs// nyon mongs skyon bral sems can don mdzad ma// thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren// phrin las rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod gnas bzhugs ru dra pho mo 'dul// drag mo 'jigs tshul phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing*// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid don rtogs 'chi ba'i tshul spangs ma// ro dang nyi zla padma'i gdan gyi tshul// rgyan rnams kun gyis rab mdzes khro mo'i sku// yon tan rdzogs mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs gcod mdzad ye shes 'od dang ldan// dug gsum gcod mdzad sku gsum lhun gyis grub// 'gro ba'i don mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen rang byung rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mi 'gyur ye shes rdo rje chos kyi sku// rtog med spros bral ye shes chos dbyings don// yang dag gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo drug gi rang bzhin rdo rje'i rigs// dpal 'bar 'jigs mdzad khro tshul 'gying bag can// bde chen rang 'byung phyag rgya chen mo'i don// nyon mongs dgrol mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin phag mo ste// sku mdog dmar ba thugs rje'i rang 'od can// 'dod dgu phun tshogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bde chen rang byung sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dur khrod rgyan rnams sku la rdzogs pa ste// gri gug kha ṭwāṃ phyag mtshan so sor bsnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin skra grol thur du spungs// spyan dmar 'dzum zhal de la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las grub pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// bde 'gro'i gnas su 'dren pa'i thugs rje can// skyon bral yang dag lha yi lhar gyur pa// rdo rje 'phrul mo che la phyag 'tshal lo// badzra wā rā hī/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra shabda pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra gandhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra ra sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra sparshe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ badzra wā rā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ lte ba'i dbus gnas rnal 'byor ma// zhe sdang gcod mdzad grub pa mo// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod// me dpung 'bar ba'i lte ba la// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga// zag med bde ba ster mdzad ma// sangs rgyas yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dhū tī'i 'od kyi rang bzhin ma// dbugs bral lte ba nyid la bzhugs// zhu ba'i rang bzhin bde chen ma// bde ster yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos po gshis kyi don ston ma// sku bzhi dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang*// bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bde chen lam sna 'dren pa'i yum// du ma ro gcig don ston ma// snang stong dbyer med ngo bo nyid// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud bzhi'i dmag las rab rgyal zhing*// bde chen byin gyis brlabs mdzad ma// rtsa rlung thig le'i ngo bo nyid// padma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud dang log 'dren zhi mdzad ma// bar chad srung zhing byin rlabs can// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul ngo bo nyid// las kyi mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog dang thun mong la sogs pa// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// rgyud bzhi smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// badzra wā rā hī/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ༈ sha chen gsur gyi bdug spos dang*// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me dang*// byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi dang*// rdo rje dri chen zhal zas dang*// rdo rje dri chu'i bdud rtsi dang*// ḍā ma oṃ āḥhūm̐/ buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ratna ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ padma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ karma ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo ka ḍā ki nī ye/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥbighnānta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu bai ḍūrya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rakta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ oṃ badzra ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi khā hi gṛhṇa ma ma rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ badzra ḍā ki nī/ buddha ḍā ki nī/ ratna ḍā ki nī/ padma ḍā ki nī/ karma ḍā ki nī/ bi shwa ḍā ki nī/ lo ka ḍā ki nī/ i daṃ ba liṃ pū dza khā hi khā hi gṛhṇa ma ma rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum mthar/ bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces phrin las bcol/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum dbul/ thal mo sbyar la 'dod gsol ni/ lhag pa'i lha mchog bcom ldan 'das// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos ldan bsam sbyor la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin du// zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de ltar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i skabs su dmigs pa ji ltar bya ba ni/

kyi// yum gyur ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dril bsil gyis/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon la bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag blo rmongs gyur pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs// gshegs gsol gyi skabs su/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra ā tsa mā naṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes zhal bsil dang*/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī badzra prokṣa ṇaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas 'thor 'thung phul la mchod yon phyag gnyis kyis gus pa dang bcas sbreng bzhin par/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes yig brgya brjod/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ ༈ rdul tshon sogs dang 'brel na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// rten gyi'am ras bris sam/ rdul tshon gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes so so'i snying po/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ brjod bzhin pas me tog thab dbus nas len pa'i tshul gyis snod du blangs/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mthar slob dpon gyis slob ma la gtad/ slob ma'i dkyil 'khor la ma gnod par gtor te dkyil 'khor gang yin de'i sngags/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/

oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi ni dkyil 'khor la// lha tshogs thams cad thim par gyur par bsam mo// //gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul nas/ slar yang me lha 'khor bcas rnams// 'bar ba'i rnam pa las bzhengs te// drang srong dag gi cha byad can// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma gang yod grangs tshad mi 'dzin par gong gsal 'jig rten pa'i skabs sor bzhag ltar 'bul dgos pas/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing ste mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres kyis/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ agna ye swā hā/ mar khu ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya swā hā/ til nag ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// sdig sgrib zhi byed las rnams la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba artha siddha ye swā hā/ yungs kar te/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad dang*// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūr wa ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// tshe srog ring du gnas pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya swā hā/ ku sha ste/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ shing tog ste mthar/ oṃ badzra ṣī bā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// rigs brgyud phun sum tshogs pa la// bar du gcod par byed rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mthar khrus gsol spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ badzra wast+ra'i bar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i snang gsal 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i dri chab 'di// drang srong me lha'i tshogs la 'bul// bzhes nas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha swā hā/
